name: Stop the Screeching
summary: In Screeching Canyon, harpies ambush supply caravans bound for Freewind Post. Their attacks may keep those caravans from traveling there.

sections.title: Caravans at Risk
sections.body: A supplier fears the harpy attacks will stop caravans from traveling to Freewind Post. You are asked to slay Screeching Harpies, Screeching Roguefeather Harpies, and Screeching Windcallers. Until then, caravans that brave the canyon remain in danger.

sections.title: Word to Suppliers
sections.body: After the harpies are dealt with, the supplier will notify those who provide goods to Freewind Post. Then the caravans will face one less threat on their journeys.

faq.q: Why are the caravans being attacked?
faq.answer: Harpies in Screeching Canyon ambushed the last few supply caravans that traveled through.

faq.q: What is at risk if the attacks continue?
faq.answer: The supplier fears no caravans will dare travel to Freewind Post if the attacks continue.
The harpies are Screeching Harpies, Screeching Roguefeather Harpies, and Screeching Windcallers.
The harpies live in Screeching Canyon.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stop the Screeching
